text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just before Seiun Sky is set to run in the Kyoto Daishoten, the results of the Mainichi Okan are announced.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka, the Otherworldly Front-Runner, has beaten El Condor Pasa and Grass Wonder by an incredible margin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Seiun Sky's fighting spirit ignited, she's determined to excite the crowd at Kyoto far more than they were in Tokyo.
